{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the actual values in revenue column
revenue_unique = df['revenue'].unique()
print(f"Unique revenue values: {revenue_unique}")

# Check if '999,999.99' exists (with comma)
test_revenue_with_comma = '999,999.99'
revenue_test_rows_comma = df[df['revenue'] == test_revenue_with_comma]

# Also check if '999999.99' exists (without comma)
revenue_test_rows_no_comma = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

print(f"Number of rows with '999,999.99': {len(revenue_test_rows_comma)}")
print(f"Number of rows with '999999.99': {len(revenue_test_rows_no_comma)}")

# Now clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the actual values after cleaning
test_revenue_clean = 999999.99
revenue_test_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] == test_revenue_clean]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue_clean = 999999.99: {len(revenue_test_clean)}")"}
